notes.title: Second Live Stream for Next Fest!!!
notes.notes:
Hello, fullbacks!

This is Fullback Simulator's second live-stream event in the Next Fest.

So far I've never participated in a Next Fest; I'm curious to see what will happen with you :)

Have fun trying the free DEMO and write me in the Community Hub about what you would like to see in the final version of the game!

Happy viewing and have fun!

notes.title: Fullback Simulator DEMO update to version 0.9.2!
notes.notes:
Hello, footballers!

I made some small cosmetic changes and fixed some bugs:

- Fixed the issue that caused the field to disappear after a certain time in the initial menu.

- Fixed the music problem that returning to the initial menu would again acquire a different volume from the settings.

- Fixed the issue that didn't allow customization of the keys in the settings.

- Now Sprint and Jump can't be activated at the same time because it made it too easy to break free from opponents' group tackles.

- I changed the background during the match; black was quite ugly.
Tell me if this green takes your attention away from the gameplay.

- Fixed a bug where Beast Mode didn't end.


I hope this simple game will ease your mind between jobs, it did with me :)

Also, just for the record, Fullback Simulator will be participating in the Next Fest in June!

notes.title: Fullback Simulator DEMO update to version 0.9.1!
notes.notes:
Hello, footballers!

This is a quick fix to resolve the following problems:

- Time in the match was not stopping when pressing ESC.

- Added a decimal digit to some values in the final summary.

- Under certain conditions, the wording "NEW RECORD" did not appear in the first parameter.

This is a very simple game, but if you find some bugs, don't hesitate to get in touch with me.

notes.title: The DEMO of Fullback Simulator is OUT!
notes.notes:
Hello, footballers!

I'm happy to announce that the DEMO of Fullback Simulator is out!

If you have some suggestions for the finale game and/or you note some bugs, you are welcome on Community Hub!

I hope you'll have fun, my friends!
